Also green: TGP2 156, job113, draw_v2 23, Vk83 13, corpus crash no-signal, render nearest/linear harness, legacy sampler guard, producer59. Current ABI resource488/descriptor64/region1184/v2 11592 with per-level arrays; specialized 3360.
